jobs.title: Manager, Principal Scientist AI & Omics
jobs.original_cv_field: Automation of Omics Analysis and Data Processing workflow

bullets.text: Lead end-to-end analysis for a sequencing-plus-analysis service: bulk RNA-seq, scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, WGS (genome-editing and vector-integration verification), differential splicing and shotgun metagenomics, delivered as decision-ready reports.
bullets.evidence: projects_2026M7 / projects_2026Q4 项目目录；客户一律匿名

bullets.text: Built an LLM-agent analysis environment in which each assay’s expert SOP is written as a specification the agent loads before working: approved analysis flow, non-default parameters, known failure modes and executable self-audit assertions. Critical rules are enforced by tool-call hooks backed by a 115-case regression suite.
bullets.evidence: ~/.claude/skills/；~/.claude/hooks/ 四套测试共 115 条（2026-10-27 实测）

bullets.text: Every formal analysis starts from a reviewable decision table (question → evidence unit → filters → metrics → permitted conclusions) with a filter-impact audit, mirroring an expert-signed agent specification.

Spatial transcriptomics pilot (Visium): independent cross-checks and double-run tests exposed silent defects that passed every standard check – uninitialized p-values in Squidpy spatial autocorrelation (inflating FDR-significant counts 20–40×), an unseeded random state in Tangram, and an unreliable deconvolution estimate (ρ = −0.01) traced to 15 reference cells.
bullets.evidence: projects_2026M7/37_spatial_visium_heart_pilot 文档 §8c；数字取自项目记录，未回原始产物复核

bullets.text: Benchmarked five differential-splicing methods against ENCODE knockdown ground truth and per-method permutation false-positive baselines (0.1%–18.2%), defining each method’s role in the production workflow.
Run production nf-core pipelines (rnaseq, sarek, taxprofiler, mag) under shared-server resource caps with automated early-failure monitoring.
